login.title: Sign in to Subtrack
login.description: Track your AI coding plans, their limits and what they're worth.
login.socialFailed: Could not start social sign-in. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Every Claude Code and Codex plan in one place. No card needed.
register.legal: By creating an account you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account exists with that email, you will receive a reset link shortly.
forgotPassword.sentMessage: We sent a reset link to <address>{{email}}</address>. It expires in 30 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.expiredText: Reset links work once and for 30 minutes. Send a new one to {{email}}.
resetPassword.expiredTextNoEmail: Reset links work once and for 30 minutes. Ask for a new one.
resetPassword.changedText: Other devices were signed out. Sign in with your new password.

session.errorMessage: We couldn't restore your session. Check your connection and try again.

acceptInvitation.description: Finish setting up your account to start working with your team.
acceptInvitation.invalidLink: This invitation link is incomplete. Ask the workspace owner to send a new invitation.
acceptInvitation.title: Join the workspace

oauth.accountNotLinked: That address already has an account with a password. Sign in with your password; once the address is verified, this button works too.
oauth.failed: That sign-in didn't complete. Try again, or use your email and password.
oauth.noAccount: There's no account here for that sign-in yet. Create one below — the provider buttons will do it in one step.

twoFactor.title: Enter your code
twoFactor.description: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {{app}}.
twoFactor.backupDescription: Use one of the codes you saved when you set up two-factor. Each works once.
